verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the story indirectly. The developer docs describe listening for real-time events and subscribing to changes such as `change_column_value` (monday-docs-27, monday-docs-7), and the integrations page markets a "real-time, cross-platform view" (monday-docs-33). None of this states that teammates' edits appear live in other users' open board sessions without a refresh. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of live multi-user UI sync or presence across open sessions, and any hands-on or independent confirmation that changes show up without refreshing.
